structure.note: Tailwind-style ramps (50–950). Semantic groups bg, fg, border plus one group per hue with the same seven roles (contrast, fg, subtle, muted, emphasized, solid, focusRing); the virtual "colorPalette" (default: gray) selects a hue per component.

color.note: The default colorPalette is gray: an un-themed primary button is near-black in light mode. The blue ramp is recorded as the usual brand candidate.

findings: No token for direction, language or script. Fonts are heading/body/mono with Inter first; letter-spacing tokens are Latin tracking values and textStyles 4xl and above apply −0.025em.

Direction is handled by the style engine, not by tokens: recipes are written with logical style props (px, ms, me, insetStart) and _rtl/_ltr conditions (9 lines mentioning rtl in the scanned theme and styled-system files).
Line heights for text styles are absolute rem values per size (sm 14px on 20px, md 16px on 24px, xs 12px on 16px) — the Tailwind pairs — with no language variation.
Density: no mode. Buttons and inputs have seven sizes (2xs…2xl) from 24–28px to 64px; the default is md = 40px.

gaps: No border-width scale beyond literal 1px in recipes; focus-ring width is not a token.
No density mode, touch mode or touch-target token.
